message:
Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"fuzz_parse_http_request","line":1650,"var":"data_copy","code":"memcpy(data_copy, data, length);","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes are copied into a persistent request buffer and become the parser input.","depends_on":[]},
  {"step":2,"file":"src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"fuzz_parse_http_request","line":1664,"var":"helper.buffer","code":"helper.buffer = &(struct lwan_value){.value = data_copy, .len = length};","note":"The copied bytes are wrapped as the request buffer that downstream parsing routines read from.","depends_on":[{"on":1,"type":"data","via":"buffer contents"}]},
  {"step":3,"file":"src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"fuzz_parse_http_request","line":1678,"var":"parse_http_request(&request)","code":"if (parse_http_request(&request) == HTTP_OK) {","note":"The fuzz harness invokes the HTTP parser on the attacker-controlled buffer.","depends_on":[{"on":2,"type":"data","via":"request buffer"}]},
  {"step":4,"file":"src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_http_request","line":1192,"var":"buffer","code":"buffer = parse_proxy_protocol(request, buffer);","note":"Because REQUEST_ALLOW_PROXY_REQS is set, the parser first interprets the beginning of the input as an optional PROXY protocol header.","depends_on":[{"on":3,"type":"control","via":"request.flags"}]},
  {"step":5,"file":"src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"read_request_finalizer","line":2660,"var":"crlfcrlf + 4","code":"STRING_SWITCH_LARGE(crlfcrlf + 4) { case MULTICHAR_CONSTANT_LARGE(0x00, 0x0d, 0x0a, 0x51, 0x55, 0x49, 0x54, 0x0a): return FINALIZER_DONE; }","note":"The finalizer accepts inputs that contain the PROXYv2 signature after the initial CRLFCRLF boundary, allowing the parser to continue into the proxy-header path.","depends_on":[{"on":2,"type":"data","via":"buffer bytes"}]},
  {"step":6,"file":"src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":154,"var":"hdr->len","code":"size = proto_signature_length + (unsigned int)ntohs(hdr->len);","note":"The proxy header length field is trusted to compute how many bytes belong to the PROXYv2 header.","depends_on":[{"on":5,"type":"data","via":"proxy header bytes"}]},
  {"step":7,"file":"src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":156,"var":"size","code":"if (UNLIKELY(size > (unsigned int)sizeof(*hdr))) return NULL; if (UNLIKELY(size >= helper->buffer->len)) return NULL;","note":"The parser bounds-checks the computed size, but later logic still relies on the header fields and surrounding buffer layout being well-formed.","depends_on":[{"on":6,"type":"control","via":"computed size"}]},
  {"step":8,"file":"src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_http_request","line":1200,"var":"request->url.value","code":"buffer = identify_http_path(request, path);","note":"After proxy parsing, the remaining bytes are treated as the HTTP request line and path.","depends_on":[{"on":4,"type":"data","via":"returned buffer pointer"}]},
  {"step":9,"file":"src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"identify_http_path","line":1360,"var":"space","code":"space = end_of_line - sizeof("HTTP/X.X");","note":"The parser derives the HTTP-version location by subtracting a fixed size from the CR position, so malformed line layouts can shift the pointer into attacker-controlled bytes.","depends_on":[{"on":8,"type":"data","via":"request line bytes"}]},
  {"step":10,"file":"src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"identify_http_path","line":1368,"var":"space++","code":"*space++ = '\0';","note":"The version token is NUL-terminated in place, mutating the shared buffer and creating a C string boundary for later comparisons.","depends_on":[{"on":9,"type":"data","via":"derived pointer"}]},
  {"step":11,"file":"src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"identify_http_path","line":1370,"var":"space","code":"STRING_SWITCH_LARGE(space) { case MULTICHAR_CONSTANT_LARGE('H','T','T','P','/','1','.','0'): ... }","note":"The parser reads a fixed-width token from the computed pointer; if the pointer lands near the end of the buffer, this becomes an out-of-bounds read on attacker-controlled input.","depends_on":[{"on":10,"type":"data","via":"version pointer"}]},
  {"step":12,"file":"src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_http_request","line":1204,"var":"url_decode(request->url.value)","code":"ssize_t decoded_len = url_decode(request->url.value);","note":"The parsed URL is then decoded in place, so any malformed path bytes that survived earlier checks are reinterpreted as percent-encoded data.","depends_on":[{"on":8,"type":"data","via":"request->url.value"}]},
  {"step":13,"file":"src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"url_decode","line":811,"var":"ch[1], ch[2]","code":"char tmp = (char)(decode_hex_digit(ch[1]) << 4 | decode_hex_digit(ch[2]));","note":"Percent-decoding reads two bytes past each '%' without independently verifying that they exist, which is the memory-safety sink when the URL ends with an incomplete escape.","depends_on":[{"on":12,"type":"data","via":"URL bytes"}]}
]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
print(p)
